# Taiye Promise K.

> AI automation developer, product builder, and student. Based in Akure, Nigeria.

Taiye Promise K. is a developer and entrepreneur who builds AI-powered tools, automation systems, and digital products. He studies at FUTA (Federal University of Technology, Akure).

## What he does

- **AI Automation**: Voice agents, WhatsApp bots, n8n workflows. Helps businesses automate slow processes.
- **Product Building**: Building Ghost Shift (anonymous job marketplace), Broken Hero (browser roguelike), Echo Vault (voice-based personal archive SaaS), and IRONBOUND.
- **Student**: Studying at the Federal University of Technology, Akure (FUTA). Tech, always.

## Selected client work

- **DB Studio Voice Agent** — Bilingual AI voice agent (French & English) handling inbound sales calls, lead qualification, and appointment booking. Built with Retell AI and Twilio.
- **Neo AI Running Coach** — WhatsApp-based AI running coach with automated subscription billing. Delivers personalized weekly training plans. Built with n8n, GPT-4o, Stripe, and Supabase.
- **Justin Project** — AI marketing automation for an e-commerce brand. Generates product image composites using Google Gemini and auto-posts to Instagram via batch processing.
- **Fashion Product Scraper** — AI-powered scraper using GPT-4 Vision to extract graphic tees from major retailers and sync to Airtable.
- **Slack AI Bot** — Multi-channel AI bot for Slack with file analysis capabilities.

## Currently building

- Ghost Shift — Anonymous job marketplace. In development.
- Broken Hero — Browser roguelike with deck-building. In development.
- Echo Vault — Voice-based personal archive SaaS. Planned.
- IRONBOUND — In development.
- LeadOro — AI-powered lead automation system. Multi-channel (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Ads). Responds in 10 seconds, qualifies leads, books appointments, follows up automatically.
